# Tweezers: two steel prongs 0.95 m long joined at one end, opening by 0.12 m at the tips, lying on
# the bench along x. Origin at the joint. Generated by make_env.py. Up Z, front -Y.
new
material new Steel --base-color 0.4118 0.6235 0.6784 --no-slot
add mesh cube --name ProngA --size 1 --location 0.47 0.035 0.03
scale 0.95 0.07 0.05
apply --scale
set rotation 0 0 3.6
apply --rotation
add mesh cube --name ProngB --size 1 --location 0.47 -0.035 0.03
scale 0.95 0.07 0.05
apply --scale
set rotation 0 0 -3.6
apply --rotation
add mesh cube --name Joint --size 1 --location 0.02 0 0.035
scale 0.12 0.14 0.07
apply --scale
select ProngA ProngB Joint
material assign Steel
active ProngA
join
rename ProngA Tweezers
shade flat
export tweezers.glb
